hederaTestnet.note: Requests settle in HTS USDC (0.0.429274, 6 dp); SETTLEMENT_ASSET=hbar switches back to native HBAR. Staking/slash is always native-HBAR escrow via the Hedera SDK. Reputation is a separate HTS ReputationBond token (bondToken, set by `pnpm setup-hts`) with freeze/pause/wipe compliance controls; on fraud the verifier freezes it and executes a multi-sig scheduled wipe via the Hedera Schedule Service. Agent identity is HCS-14 (uaid:aid:hedera:testnet:0.0.x) published to the registry topic via the Hedera Agent Kit. No Solidity anywhere — HCS + HTS + Schedule + Mirror Node, all SDK-native.
